function validateStep(step=index){const miss=[];if(step===0){if(!S.name)miss.push('customer name');if(!S.phone)miss.push('mobile number');if(!S.whyNow)miss.push('why now');if(!S.outcome)miss.push('desired result')}if(step===1){if(PHOTO_COUNT<3)miss.push('at least 3 photos');if(!S.fill)miss.push('fullness')}if(step===2){if(!S.sortMethod)miss.push('sorting plan');if(!S.loads)miss.push('estimated truckloads');if(!S.truckPlacement)miss.push('truck placement')}if(step===4){if(!S.jobDate||!S.startTime||!S.endTime)miss.push('job date and arrival window');if(S.startTime&&S.endTime&&timeMins(S.endTime)<=timeMins(S.startTime))miss.push('an end time after the start')}return miss}

async function photoList(){if(!S.jobId)S.jobId=uid();const db=await dbOpen();return new Promise(res=>{const out=[],tx=db.transaction('p','readonly');tx.objectStore('p').index('job').openCursor(IDBKeyRange.only(S.photoDraftJobId||S.jobId)).onsuccess=e=>{const c=e.target.result;if(c){if(c.value.tag==='before')out.push(c.value);c.continue()}else res(out.sort((a,b)=>a.at-b.at))}})}

async function addPhotos(input){invalidateAcceptance();if(!S.jobId)S.jobId=uid();const db=await dbOpen();for(const f of Array.from(input.files||[])){const dataUrl=await fileData(f),tx=db.transaction('p','readwrite');tx.objectStore('p').put({id:uid(),job:S.photoDraftJobId||S.jobId,tag:'before',dataUrl,at:Date.now()});await new Promise(res=>{tx.oncomplete=res;tx.onerror=res})}input.value='';await mountPhotos();save()}
